refunds: Refunds were $8,105 (19.3% refund rate), down from $12,091 last week. King ($2,018) and Queen ($1,821) toppers had the largest refunds; check their return reasons.
pacing_reco: October closed at $414.0K. November starts slower: Nov 1 sold $6,250 vs $12,558 on the same day last year, so King and Queen stock matter before BF/CM.
ads_context: Ad spend dropped 35% to $4,354 while ad sales fell 15% to $24,031.
ACoS improved to 18.1% (from 23.7%) and TACoS to 8.9% (from 11.7%).
ads_strategy: Branded keywords returned $20,951 on $2,533 spend (12.1% ACoS) and brought 63 orders.
Category keywords cost $936 for $760 in sales; Streaming TV spent $360 with no attributed sales.
